offering_description.value: Provides water quality instrumentation, analytics and treatment solutions (Hach, Trojan Technologies, McCrometer, ChemTreat) and product identification equipment such as coding, marking, packaging and labeling systems (Videojet, Linx, Esko, X-Rite, Pantone). Sells to utilities, industrial plants, and consumer goods, food, beverage and pharmaceutical manufacturers, made in own factories with consumables and service.

primary_products.value: water testing instruments and reagents; UV disinfection systems; flow meters; industrial water treatment chemicals; industrial inkjet and laser coders and printers

primary_services.value: equipment servicing and maintenance; water treatment programs and monitoring; software support; calibration and color management services

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial plants, food, beverage, pharma and consumer goods manufacturers, brand owners; B2G: municipal water and wastewater utilities and agencies

end_markets.value: municipal water and wastewater; industrial water; food and beverage; pharmaceuticals; consumer packaged goods

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, UV systems, meters, coders and printers, plus recurring consumables like reagents, inks and chemicals; service fees: installation, maintenance, calibration and service contracts; subscription: software and cloud analytics subscriptions

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments, treatment systems and coding equipment from purchased components, sold to utilities and manufacturers; service provider: water treatment programs and equipment servicing for industrial and municipal customers; software / platform: packaging workflow and color management software sold to brand owners and printers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: water analytics and treatment, and product identification, sharing instrumentation, consumables and recurring-revenue models

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving utilities, large industrial and manufacturing accounts; distributors / dealers: channel partners and distributors for instruments and coding equipment; online: e-commerce for consumables and reagents

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: water quality and drinking water standards, EPA and NSF certifications, food and pharma labeling and traceability rules
